mechanism.driver: GitHub branch protection and/or repository rulesets
mechanism.trigger: Configure platform enforcement for the declared maturity topology so direct writes cannot bypass the repository-local promotion and validation gates, then rerun the read-only external-settings probe.
mechanism.verification: Live GitHub REST evidence must show the intended branches protected or covered by active rulesets, required checks/reviews bound to the promotion path, and force-push/deletion/direct bypass policy observed as configured.
mechanism.falsifier: Any declared maturity branch remaining unprotected and uncovered by an active enforcing ruleset, missing required gate binding, or inability to re-observe the settings keeps the token open.

close_when: main and the declared maturity branches are covered by branch protection and/or active rulesets
the intended required checks and review policy are observable from GitHub
force-push/deletion/direct-write bypass policy is explicitly observed
a fresh read-only receipt verifies the configured state without relying on repository prose
added_open_mechanisms.claim_boundary: Platform enforcement protects repository process integrity only; it cannot promote any scientific claim or replace scientific review.

invariants: The historical mechanism registry and V2 delta remain immutable custody.
Closing unknown external settings does not erase the observed absence of platform enforcement.
The successor is P0 because direct writes can bypass repository-local promotion policy when no platform protection/ruleset exists.
No scientific claim state changes as a result of GitHub platform enforcement.
